name: scheduled metrics dispatcher retirement
$comment: CHAOS-3128: the obsolete Beat sweep is intentionally retired, not replaced by an empty Go producer. These mutations prove that reintroducing the Beat key or a metrics ScheduledJob writer fails independently derived guards.

mutations.rationale: The retired Beat name must not silently return as an unowned or nominally-owned schedule.
A new metrics ScheduledJob writer invalidates the no-writer evidence that authorizes this retirement and requires a fresh scheduler design review.
